seo.werewolfTitle: Word Werewolf – Free Online Party Game
seo.werewolfDescription: Play Word Werewolf online with friends. Everyone submits a word, one is chosen secretly. Reason, bluff, and vote to uncover the mafia. No downloads needed – play instantly in your browser.

werewolf.tagline: A social deduction game with a twist of words
werewolf.about: Word Werewolf is a party game where every player contributes a word. One word is randomly selected and revealed to all. Town players must reason and vote to eliminate the hidden mafia, while mafia members secretly coordinate to take over. The twist: the chosen word adds a unique theme to every round.
steps: The host creates a room and shares the room code with friends.
The host sets the number of Town and Mafia players, then starts the game.
Each player secretly submits a word. One word is randomly chosen and revealed.
During the Day phase, all players discuss and vote to eliminate a suspected mafia member.
During the Night phase, mafia members secretly vote to eliminate a town player.
Town wins if all mafia are eliminated. Mafia wins if they equal or outnumber town.
ruleList: Day vote tie: no one is eliminated that round.
Mafia night vote tie: a random target among the top-voted is chosen.
Once the game starts, no new players can join until the host stops the game.
Eliminated players can spectate but cannot vote.
